persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.
bank.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
bank.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
bank.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

messages.text: Could you make an ad for ClearDay, which is a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan? I like the idea because my own to-do lists always seem to get more overwhelming instead of more useful. I don't have screenshots or a logo, so create a simple demo screen yourself, and the ad should be 8 seconds long in 16:9. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Give it a calm blue-and-white look with no sound, and any other wording is up to you.
